notes: Two instruction-set branches compete on "the evil eye": the adjective+noun term-of-art branch would require the genus `(Inheritance evil_eye eye)` ("the genus itself is always emitted either way"), while the non-compositional-idiom branch (`hot_dog`) forbids decomposition; the parse took the idiom branch, which is the semantically right one here but the ambiguity is real. Phrasal `ward_off` with no genus, inanimate transitive subject as `Agent`, unchanged object as `Theme`, and `Future` from "will" all follow the instructions exactly.
